card.name: Small words before urinary and genital terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "include", "and" and "including" when they come just before a urinary or genital infection term. Seen in symptom lists and warnings about genitourinary infections.

modes.label: Article before genital area
modes.description: The word "the" right before "genital or perineal area" in a warning about swelling or pain.
modes.example: Immediately evaluate patients presenting with pain or tenderness, erythema, or swelling in<< the>> genital or perineal area, along

modes.label: Lists of urinary symptoms
modes.description: "include", "The" or "and" opening or inside a list of cystitis symptoms.
modes.example: Some common symptoms<< include>>: -The need to go all the time

modes.label: Including in urinary infection lists
modes.description: "including" after a urinary tract infection term in a dosing table.
modes.example: Complicated urinary tract infections,<< including>> pyelonephritis 1 g
